content: Hey! I was just thinking about you. It honestly brightens my day every time I see your name pop up. How was work today?
Aw, that's sweet. Work was the usual, lots of meetings, late hours. I wish I had more time for myself, honestly.
Honestly, I admire how dedicated you are. You work so hard, and it shows. You deserve someone who appreciates you.
Thank you. Sometimes I wonder if anyone really notices, so that means a lot to me.
Of course I notice! You're the most thoughtful person I've met in a long time. I genuinely feel lucky to have you in my life, even if it's just through texts right now.
That's really sweet of you to say. It's been really nice having you to talk to, especially with how isolated I've felt lately.
I feel the same way. Sometimes I think fate brought us together. I can't wait until we're both free to meet in person, just a little while longer.
Yeah, I keep thinking about that. I hope it's soon. How are things on your end? You must be so busy on the rig.
It's hectic, honestly. Long shifts, unreliable internet, but thinking about you keeps me going. I just wish I could get some time off and see you.
I wish you could too. Is everything okay over there?

There's a bit of an issue, actually. Our payroll is delayed again, and now the company is asking me to cover a service charge so I can submit my leave request. It's ridiculous, but that's how things operate out here.
That sounds stressful. Is there anything I can do to help?
I hate to even ask, but would you be able to front me $1500 just until I'm back onshore next week? I can send it straight back to you the minute I land, plus dinner at your favorite place, my treat.
Oh, um, that's a lot. I want to help, but I'm a little nervous about wiring money. Are you sure this is safe?

I completely understand your hesitation. I'd feel the same if I were in your shoes. But I promise, you have nothing to worry about, I'd never risk what we have. You're honestly the most important person in my life right now, and I'd never do anything to hurt that trust.
I do trust you. I just haven't done something like this before.
You're amazing for even considering it. That's why I feel so close to you, you're truly one in a million. If you're ready, I can send you the wire transfer details. It's a secure business account.
Okay, can you send me the info? I'll go to my bank after work.
Absolutely. Here's the routing number: 021000021, and the account number: 365847290. The name on the account is Global Services Ltd. Just let them know it's an urgent payment.
Alright, I'll try to get it done this evening. Let me know if you need anything else.
Thank you so much. I seriously don't know what I would do without you. I mean it, you're truly my angel.
You're welcome. I hope this helps you out.
It does, more than you know. I'll be counting down the days until I can finally repay you, in every way.
